props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to close the color picker when a swatch is selected

props.name: defaultFormat
props.description:
The initial color format when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color format of the color picker.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the color picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the color picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial color value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color value of the color picker.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the color picker is disabled

props.name: format
props.description: The controlled color format to use

props.name: hideMode
props.description:
How to hide content when mounted but not present.
- `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive.
- `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the color picker. Useful for composition.

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: The initial focus element when the color picker is opened.

props.name: inline
props.description: Whether to render the color picker inline

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the color picker is invalid

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: name
props.description: The name for the form input

props.name: onEnterComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

props.name: onFormatChange
props.description: Function called when the color format changes

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the user opens or closes the color picker.

props.name: onPointerDownOutside
props.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the value changes, as the user drags.

props.name: onValueChangeEnd
props.description: Handler that is called when the user stops dragging.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the color picker

props.name: openAutoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto focus the color picker when it is opened

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options for the color picker

props.name: present
props.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the color picker is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the color picker is required

props.name: skipAnimationOnMount
props.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled color value of the color picker

props.description: The controlled value.
